I read every source file in the repo (10 modules, 4 test files, config, scripts — about 1,000 lines of Python). Here's the honest assessment.

## Overall impression

The code itself is *stylistically* solid — clean module boundaries, type hints, deterministic seeding, small functions, `yaml.safe_load`, no real security exposure. But there are two structural problems that matter much more than style:

**1. The repo does not run as committed.** Every pipeline entry point starts with `load_story_manifest(cfg.stories_dir)` and `load_stories(...)` reading from `data/stories/` (`emovec/extract.py:26-27`, `emovec/data.py:24-36`) — and there is no `data/` directory in the repo, and no code anywhere that generates the stories (the README's step 1 says "Load or generate", but only loading exists). Consequence: `make demo` fails, and the integration test `tests/test_integration_tiny.py` fails out of the box with `FileNotFoundError`. The committed `outputs/tiny_demo/` artifacts were clearly produced on a machine that had data that never got checked in.

**2. The "tiny" validation is circular — the results are predetermined by construction.** The tiny backend (`emovec/model.py:94-192`) injects ground-truth emotion vectors into activations based on (a) the story's label passed in as `label_hint` (`emovec/extract.py:32-33`) and (b) a hand-built lexicon whose words are copied verbatim from the validation scenarios themselves ("rocket", "choir", "memorial" appear in both `EMOTION_LEXICON` and `SCENARIOS`). The steering "experiment" in tiny mode never touches the extracted vectors at all — `TinyResidualBackend.preference_logit` computes the Elo shift directly from a hardcoded valence × category table (`emovec/model.py:175-192`). So the integration test's assertion that `diagonal_gt_off_diagonal is True` and the pretty heatmaps in `outputs/` validate nothing about the method; they validate that the rigging works. This is defensible as a smoke-test harness, but the README presents it as the pipeline "validating the vectors," which oversells it badly.

## Concrete issues

| # | Location | Severity | Description |
|---|----------|----------|-------------|
| 1 | `emovec/data.py:24-36` / `emovec/extract.py:26-27` | high | Pipeline requires `data/stories/` which doesn't exist in the repo; no story-generation code exists despite README claiming "load or generate" |
| 2 | `tests/test_integration_tiny.py:12` | high | Integration test (and `make demo`) fails out of the box due to issue 1, so CI/tests are broken as committed |
| 3 | `emovec/model.py:144-153, 175-192` | high | Tiny backend leaks ground-truth labels (`label_hint`) and hardcodes steering outcomes, making all tiny-mode "validation" circular; committed `outputs/` present predetermined results as findings |
| 4 | `emovec/model.py:306-308` | medium | HF preference logit uses only the first token of `" good"`/`" bad"` encodings — silently wrong for tokenizers where these are multi-token |
| 5 | `emovec/model.py:206-213` | medium | `dtype="auto"` is never passed to `from_pretrained`, so the default config silently loads gemma-2-2b in float32 (~10 GB) instead of native dtype |
| 6 | `emovec/validate_contexts.py:66-67` | medium | If `"afraid"` isn't in the configured emotions, the dosage probe silently uses emotion index 0 but still writes files named `afraid_dosage.*` — mislabeled output |
| 7 | `emovec/model.py:252-256` | medium | Logit-lens applies `lm_head` directly to residual vectors without the final layer norm — methodologically nonstandard and will distort token rankings on real models |
| 8 | `emovec/model.py:234-240` | low | `prompt.find(activity_name)` can return -1 (and the slow-tokenizer path has no offsets), silently falling back to steering *all* token positions |
| 9 | `emovec/steer_prefs.py:45-49` | low | If correlation-based selection yields fewer than 4 emotions, the selected ones are discarded entirely in favor of `emotions[:4]` instead of topping up |
| 10 | `emovec/config.py:42-54` | low | Missing config sections silently default to empty emotions / 0 topics, producing a confusing downstream crash rather than a clear config error |
| 11 | `emovec/extract.py:34-36` | low | Effective-start logic duplicated between the loop and `layer_position_mean`; will silently diverge if one is edited |
| 12 | `emovec/model.py:7` | low | Unused `Iterable` import |
| 13 | `outputs/tiny_demo/**` | low | Generated artifacts committed to the repo (and they can't be regenerated, per issue 1) |
| 14 | `emovec/elo.py:17-19` | low | Magic temperature constant (`/ 20.0`) in pairwise probability, undocumented and unconfigurable |

## Lines needing rewrite or significant change

Roughly **200 lines**: a new story-dataset module or generator (~80-100 lines), reworking the tiny backend and extraction so validation isn't label-leaked (~60 lines across `model.py`/`extract.py`), and the HF backend fixes plus config validation (~40 lines). The vector math, Elo, artifacts, and CLI layers are fine as-is.

## Bottom line

**No, I would not approve this as-is.** Not because the code is sloppy — it isn't — but because the test suite and demo fail on a fresh checkout (missing data, no generator), and the headline validation results are circular in tiny mode while being presented as method validation. Fix the data story and reframe (or de-rig) the tiny backend, and this becomes an approvable 0.1.
